name: Browser Operator
notes: The repository is a modified Chrome DevTools frontend; the AI Chat panel holds the agent framework, accessibility-tree and extraction tools, memory, MCP client and evaluation code, and agent-server is a Node.js HTTP and WebSocket wrapper that sends tasks to agents and captures pages over CDP. The README offers macOS 10.15+ and Windows 10+ builds; the latest release is v0.6.0 (2025-12-11) and the last push was 2026-03-19. The LICENSE is the Chromium Authors' BSD-3-Clause text inherited from DevTools; third_party components keep their own terms.
summary: Chromium-based AI browser whose DevTools panel runs a multi-agent framework (web-task, action, form-fill, research and verification agents) over accessibility trees with OpenRouter, OpenAI, Groq or LiteLLM models.
